metadata.title: Secure Email

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating email as a secure, trustworthy, and institutionally governed communication system.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Institutional email systems encompassing identity, threat protection, data governance, workflow relay, bulk messaging, and automation.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that all required trust properties for secure institutional email are satisfied.

props.name: data-object
props.remarks: Institutional email communications and associated metadata treated as governed, auditable information assets.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Email assumes baseline delivery assurance, identity binding, and accountability.

props.name: depends-on

props.name: depends-on

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Secure Email requires controls preventing misuse and leakage of sensitive information.

props.name: depends-on

props.name: depends-on

props.name: depends-on

props.name: depends-on

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced as the primary normative guidance for trustworthy email, defining requirements for authentication, policy enforcement, monitoring, and accountability.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for foundational guidance on secure email system administration, message handling, and auditability.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced to frame email as a critical enabling service with cyber resiliency concerns including misuse, abuse at scale, and recovery.

metadata.remarks: Secure Email is a composite pattern asserting that all foundational, defensive, and governance requirements for institutional email are satisfied. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for solution patterns, risk analysis, and system security and privacy plans.

components.title: Email Core
components.description: Baseline trust assumptions for institutional email transport and accountability.

components.title: Email Identity
components.description: Defensible sender identity, delegation governance, and impersonation resistance.

components.title: Email Threat Protection
components.description: Detection and response to malicious and deceptive email activity.

components.title: Email Data Protection
components.description: Controls preventing inappropriate disclosure and over-sharing of email content.

components.title: Email Records
components.description: Institutional record management and evidentiary integrity for email communications.

components.title: Email Notification Gateway
components.description: Trusted delivery of system-generated email messages.

components.title: Email Collaboration Relay
components.description: Safe and authoritative use of email in workflow and collaboration contexts.

components.title: Email Bulk Messaging Gateway
components.description: Governed high-volume outbound email with consent and abuse protections.
